For each criterion, choose the real check that exercises it (the project's tests, type-checker, build or linter in its check-only form, or the changed command itself), run it, and record the command, exit code and key output lines or counts. A criterion no real check can cover is reported as not run, with the reason. Run checks as the project defines them, and report a wrong or flaky check instead of weakening, skipping or tailoring it.
